svg.title: United States: construction sheet
svg.text: A star’s or sun’s size is the circle through its points, shown dashed.
50 white stars on a grid of 9 rows by 11 columns, in alternate cells from the top left, 19H/300 apart along the fly and 7H/130 down.
The vertical variant has a sheet of its own.
Not measured on this sheet: the triangle fold.
Sizes as parts of the hoist, H. The white star’s center is marked +.
